description: Candidate four-step single-Spark core-node ComfyUI text-to-image recipe using Black Forest Labs' official NVFP4 transformer for lower artifact storage and native Blackwell execution. Per-job knobs choose the seed, the output width and height (256 to 2048 in multiples of 16) and the step count (1 to 16, default 4).
title: FLUX.2 Klein 4B NVFP4 ComfyUI single Spark
